post.caption: Zales sold diamonds for a penny down. Founder Morris Zalefsky shortened his name to Zale. His first try was two display cases in a Graham, Texas drugstore. In 1924, the first Zales store opened in Wichita Falls, Texas. Customers paid a penny down and a dollar a week. By 1941, twelve stores stood in Texas and Oklahoma. In 1946, the company moved its headquarters to Dallas. In 1957, Zales opened its first shopping center store. Signet Jewelers bought Zales in 2014. A Texas marker stands at 800 Ohio Avenue in Wichita Falls.
